notablePrerequisites:
Second Wind attached to Kelpie Guide.
Kelpie Guide does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kelpie Guide's first ability by tapping it, targeting Second Wind.
Kelpie Guide triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Second Wind.
Activate Second Wind's second ability by tapping it, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Repeat.
